notes: Primary-record queue for reconstructing cause-of-death posture, investigative status, evidence custody, victim-record continuity, DOJ document references, and cross-border preservation without inferring homicide, suicide, coercion, concealment, or coordinated elimination.

items.record_class: Nanterre prosecutor statement, death-investigation opening record, scene classification, and case reference
items.activation_effect: Establishes the official death-investigation posture, date, place, authority, and whether any suspicious-circumstances determination was made.
items.notes: Reuters reports the prosecutor posture; the official statement or case record remains required for primary verification.

items.record_class: Autopsy, toxicology, medical-examiner, and final cause-and-manner-of-death records
items.activation_effect: Resolves the medically supportable cause and manner of death and prevents speculation from substituting for forensic evidence.
items.notes: Preserve the difference between preliminary findings, toxicology, final opinion, and any sealed or family-restricted records.

items.record_class: French investigative chronology before death, including summonses, interviews, searches, seizures, complaints, referrals, and prosecutorial decisions
items.activation_effect: Determines whether Siad was a witness, suspect, target, uncharged subject, or merely referenced person and what investigative opportunities existed before death.
items.notes: Do not infer inactivity or active targeting from public silence; seek formal status and dated procedural records.

items.record_class: Complete attorney statement and representation records concerning charge status, innocence assertions, and prior contact with investigators
likely_custodians: French media holding the full interview
items.activation_effect: Preserves the defense position in full and distinguishes no formal charge from no investigation, no complaint, or no evidentiary interest.
items.notes: Reuters carries the reported statement; the complete original statement, date, and context remain required.

items.record_class: DOJ Epstein-file references to Daniel Siad, with document identifiers, page locations, authorship, date, context, and evidentiary role
items.activation_effect: Replaces aggregate mention counts with claim-level mapping showing whether each reference is a contact record, allegation, scheduling item, address-book entry, witness statement, or duplicate.
items.notes: The reported nearly 2,000 mentions must be deduplicated and classified before any network or conduct inference is permitted.

items.record_class: Victim complaints, witness statements, investigative referrals, and procedural status of allegations involving rape or trafficking
items.activation_effect: Separates reported allegations, formal complaints, corroborating evidence, prosecutorial action, and unresolved claims while preserving victim evidence after the subject's death.
items.notes: Protect identities and sensitive details; do not convert allegations or denials into findings.

items.record_class: Digital-device, account, communications, business-record, financial, travel, photographic, and agency-record custody inventory
items.activation_effect: Determines which evidence existed, what was secured before or after death, who holds it, and whether reconstruction remains possible without testimony.
items.notes: Track each object by custodian, legal authority, hash or identifier, acquisition date, access status, and succession history.

items.record_class: Cross-border preservation requests, mutual legal assistance, subpoenas, letters rogatory, and evidence-transfer records
items.activation_effect: Establishes whether French and U.S. authorities preserved or transferred evidence before or after the death and which requests remain pending.
items.notes: Record request date, requesting authority, scope, response, legal basis, and unresolved gaps.

items.record_class: Relationship and business-network records connecting Siad, Jean-Luc Brunel, Jeffrey Epstein, agencies, recruiters, travel, payments, and identified intermediaries
items.activation_effect: Supports a traceable network map that distinguishes direct records, hearsay, duplicate references, business contact, and alleged conduct.
items.notes: No adjacency alone may be treated as proof of criminal participation.

items.record_class: Post-death rumor, correction, amplification, and source-succession register
items.activation_effect: Separates verified death and investigation facts from unsupported claims of murder, suicide, coercion, concealment, or coordinated elimination.
items.notes: Preserve original claims, timestamps, corrections, deletions, and authoritative updates append-only.
